Shitet apartament 1+1+parkim, Rezidenca OXA
Shitet apartament 1+1+post parkimi ne rezidencen e sapoperfunduar OXA, ne rrugen e Kokonozeve, Fresk. Ne nje nga rezidencat me te mira dhe te reja te Tiranes ofrohet nje apartament modern dhe komod, me hapesire 64 m2 bruto, 55 m2 neto. Apartamenti organizohet nga kuzhina, kendi i gatimit, dhoma e gjumit dhe ballkoni. Apartamenti eshte i sapomobiluar dhe me çertifikate pronesie.
description_en: Apartment 1+1+parking for sale, OXA Residence Apartment 1+1+parking post for sale in the newly completed OXA residence, on Kokonozeve street, Fresk. In one of the best and new residences in Tirana, a modern and comfortable apartment is offered, with an area of ​​64 m2 gross, 55 m2 net. The apartment is organized by the kitchen, kitchenette, bedroom and balcony. The apartment is newly furnished and has a certificate of ownership.
